headline: German Economy Expands 0.2% in Third Quarter, Preliminary Data Shows
summary: Preliminary figures show the German economy grew 0.2% in the third quarter, with annual growth reaching 1.3% after price adjustments.
why: As Europe's largest economy, German gross domestic product data serves as a key driver for broader eurozone economic momentum and market sentiment.

impacts.name: German GDP
impacts.why: Preliminary data showed third-quarter growth outperforming expectations.
